info.name: Tigris Object Storage (S3-Compatible) Buckets Objects API
List objects in a bucket (ListObjectsV2 / ListObjects).

params.name: bucket
params.description: Bucket name (also usable as a virtual-host subdomain of t3.storage.dev).

params.name: list-type
params.description: Set to 2 for ListObjectsV2.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Limits the response to keys that begin with the prefix.

params.name: delimiter
params.description: Groups keys sharing a common prefix into CommonPrefixes.

params.name: continuation-token
params.description: Token returned by a prior truncated response for pagination.

params.name: max-keys
params.description: Maximum number of keys to return.

items.docs: List objects in a bucket (ListObjectsV2 / ListObjects).

items.docs: Stores an object. Supply x-amz-storage-class to set the tier (STANDARD, STANDARD_IA, GLACIER, GLACIER_IR). Provide x-amz-copy-source to perform a server-side CopyObject instead of a body upload. Custom metadata (x-amz-meta-*) and SHA256 checksums are supported.
